keyFindings.description: Refresh drops a live bucket read when the epoch moves during kv.Get (MarkCurrent false), then answers r.Get from the cache, which can be ErrKeyNotFound. Every caller is about to take something away (GET /v1/registry -> Dispatch claim lapse, releaseExpiredRoleClaim, sessionMayBeLive for the interest reaper). Before this PR Refresh always applied its read. Fix: return the decoded read uncached when it is not applied (as store.Registry.Get does at store/kv.go:778-796), also when the revision fence drops it; add a test that moves the epoch during the Get.

The stream-confirmation gate runs one synchronous STREAM.INFO (up to bus.RequestTimeout, 10 s) per delivered record whenever the last confirmation is older than 4 s; a failed or slow (>4 s) STREAM.INFO never advances confirmedAt, so under a degraded JetStream API every record waits its own read. The copy falls behind while Following() and Servable() stay true, and pruneLocked drops live rows whose heartbeats are queued: GET /v1/sessions answers 200 without them. Fix: never more than one confirmation per probe interval (records share the in-flight/last attempt), or stop following when confirmations keep failing so the stale episode and its refilling 503 apply.

The PR deleted bus.KeyValue's checked Watch/WatchFiltered/History wrappers but still embeds nats.KeyValue exported, so kv.Watch/History/Keys/ListKeys/WatchAll promote to nats.go's legacy watcher: unchecked keys (the type doc's promise) and the v1.50.0 init-timer panic the round-3 change exists to remove. bus/kv_key_test.go:193,202 already calls kv.Keys(). Fix: unexported embedding with forwarded Bucket/Status (or shadow methods that refuse), and drop the KeyValue{KeyValue: h} no-watch mode.

Two consumers of the new refilling 503 read it as the session's absence: wait_for_session_clear returns 0 on any failed curl, and own_row leaves row_json empty on a non-200, which the delete-confirm and control arms take as 'unlisted' / 'stayed gone' (false verdict_pass). The PR fixed the same pattern in smoke-channel.sh and stage3-4b13b-acceptance.sh; apply it here.

The PR adds refusals at process boundaries (listener GET /v1/sessions and /v1/interests/ 503 code refilling past the boot gate; Dispatch 503 ENVOY_REFILLING on /api/v1/agents and both subscriber routes; gauges with no sample) and carries no '## Contract change census'. Add it with the search commands, every hit and its disposition (incl. listener-deploy-probe.test.sh's 'service starting' fixture and internal/smoke/listener_test.go), and the rollout line.

Agent tools print route_status unknown as 'the Envoy listener did not answer' even when route_status_reason is refilling (the listener did answer); :3195 drops route_status_reason. Branch on the reason so the agent-facing text is true.
